claims: One bounded Codex work order was delivered to the exact disposable native task and returned a schema-conformant receipt.
A repeated prepare operation for the same received dispatch returned should_send=false.
limitations: Textual receipt and host-tool metadata; no independent operating-system audit of the remote task.
The Codex API exposed one turn identifier for the user-message/assistant-response turn rather than separate request and response identifiers.
No other provider and no semantic work-product quality was tested.
